summary: Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company registered in Selangor on June 15, 2018, with a share capital of 250,000 and a registration number of SYN-000029, operating in the retail industry with a nature of business focused on the retail of textiles and baju kurung. The company is managed by five directors—Director 1 (Managing Director), Director 2 (Independent Director), Director 3, Director 4, and Director 5 (Executive Director)—who also act as its shareholders holding 12.21%, 8.32%, 58.25%, and 21.22% respectively. Over its financial years ending in 2022, 2023, and 2024, the company maintained unqualified audits by Audit Firm 8, growing its revenue from 5,130,131 to 5,352,856 while reporting profits after tax of 113,910, 97,951, and 96,805 respectively, and currently shows no recorded litigation cases.

Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated on April 1, 1995, based in Kuala Lumpur within the hospitality industry, operating as a travel agency for umrah and inbound tourism with a share capital of 2,500,000 and registration number SYN-000067. The company is managed by four directors—including Managing Director Director 1, Independent Director Director 3, and Directors 2 and 4—who also act as shareholders holding 47.38%, 34.78%, and 17.84% respectively. Financially, the company was audited by Audit Firm 7 with unqualified opinions across the 2022, 2023, and 2024 financial years, during which it reported declining revenues from 49,467,702 to 43,292,441, increasing net losses from 4,244,828 to 7,515,861, and total assets decreasing from 71,592,364 to 62,655,189, while recording no active litigation cases.

Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited healthcare company incorporated in Kelantan on April 30, 1993, with a share capital of 500,000 and a nature of business focused on community pharmacy and health supplements. The company is led by five directors—who also serve as its individual shareholders owning varying percentages—and has maintained unqualified audit opinions from Audit Firm 5 across financial years 2022 to 2024, during which it experienced declining revenues from 5,529,168 in 2022 to 4,835,417 in 2024, alongside increasing net losses rising from 516,132 to 1,080,511 over the same period.

Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000165) is an active private limited company incorporated on September 6, 1992, based in Pulau Pinang with a share capital of 2,500,000, operating in the logistics industry focusing on last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching. The company is led by five directors—including Managing Director Director 1 and major individual shareholders Director 5 (98.34%) and Director 4 (1.66%)—and has shown consistent growth from the financial years 2022 to 2024, raising its revenue from 10,874,080 to 21,522,626 and profit after tax from 431,162 to 913,861, all backed by unqualified audits from Audit Firm 5. Additionally, the company was involved in a settled debt recovery case as a plaintiff filed in the Sessions Court of Pulau Pinang on September 26, 2024, for a claim amount of 169,800.0.

Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd., registered under number SYN-000217 as an active private limited company in Selangor since December 7, 1991, operates in the education industry with a nature of business focused on private kindergartens and nurseries in Johor Bahru (Tadika swasta dan taska di Johor Bahru) and a share capital of 2,500,000. The company is led by Director 1 as Managing Director (appointed May 25, 1995) holding 51.02% of shares and Director 2 as a Director (appointed April 21, 2000) holding 48.98% of shares. Over the financial years 2022 to 2024, audited by Audit Firm 3—which issued an unqualified opinion in 2022 and 2024 and a disclaimer of opinion in 2023—the company experienced revenue growth from 2,976,052 in 2022 to 5,606,840 in 2024, with corresponding net profits after tax rising from 138,435 to 386,389, total assets expanding from 3,366,741 to 6,342,892, and total equity increasing from 1,311,106 to 1,739,735, while having no recorded litigation cases.

Global Everbright Store Sdn. Bhd. (registration number SYN-000267) is an active private limited company incorporated on October 28, 1990, in Kuala Lumpur, with a share capital of 500,000 and a former name of Sinar Industries Sdn. Bhd. operating in the retail industry with a nature of business focused on the retail of textiles and baju kurung. The company is managed by three directors—Director 1 (Managing Director, appointed January 5, 2024), Director 2 (Executive Director, appointed August 1, 2007), and Director 3 (Independent Director, appointed December 12, 2008)—who are also the shareholders holding 89.67% and 10.33% of shares, respectively. Financially, the company reported revenues of 17,700,737 in 2022, 18,056,230 in 2023, and 19,374,478 in 2024, with all three financial years audited by Audit Firm 2 resulting in unqualified opinions. Additionally, the company has been involved in five litigation cases as a plaintiff concerning breach of contract and debt recovery, which include two settled cases, one pending case, one dismissed case, and one withdrawn case.
